simple.meaning: מִשְׁפָּת (mishpâth) is a Hebrew word meaning “a stall for cattle (only dual).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִשְׁפָּת (H4942) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 49:14, with occurrences in Genesis, Judges.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁפָּת (H4942) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִשְׁפָּת (H4942) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִשְׁפָּת (mishpâth) / H4942 is traced through Genesis 49:14, Judges 5:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
